question: Which mineral found in fruits helps to lower and regulate blood pressure?
explanation: Spot on! Potassium is fantastic for the heart because it helps ease tension in your blood vessel walls, keeping your blood pressure steady. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T010#GNS227_U4_T010_h1)

question: How does vitamin C from fruits help your body use iron better?

options.A: It breaks down complex proteins in animal meat
options.B: It directly converts red blood cells into hemoglobin
options.C: It prevents the liver from storing excess iron
options.D: It enhances the absorption of non-heme iron in the gut

explanation: You got it! Vitamin C teams up with plant-based iron in your tummy, making it much easier for your body to absorb. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T010#GNS227_U4_T010_h1)

question: What is the recommended daily target for fruit and vegetable portions for adults?

options.C: As many as possible without limit

explanation: Correct! Aiming for at least five portions a day is a wonderful, simple habit to keep your body healthy and strong. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T010#GNS227_U4_T010_h2)

question: A pregnant woman asks why she needs more fruit servings now. What is the best response?

options.A: Eating more fruit is only needed to prevent weight loss in the third trimester.
options.B: You must replace all your meals with fresh fruit juices during pregnancy.
options.C: Your body needs higher vitamins and fiber to support increased metabolic demands and growth.
options.D: Pregnancy completely stops your body from absorbing vitamins from regular food.

explanation: Well done! Pregnancy is a time of double duty—maternal tissues and the growing baby both need extra vitamins and fiber. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T010#GNS227_U4_T010_h2)

question: Why is a standard serving size for dried fruit much smaller than fresh fruit?

options.A: Dried fruit expands rapidly inside the human stomach
options.B: Manufacturers add synthetic preservatives to dried fruits
options.C: Water removal concentrates its natural sugars and calories
options.D: The digestive system cannot process dried fruit easily

explanation: That's right! Without water taking up space, dried fruit is packed tightly with natural sugars, so a smaller handful is plenty. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T010#GNS227_U4_T010_h3)

question: Which of these is a standard single serving of fresh fruit for an adult?

options.A: Five liters of blended fruit smoothie
options.B: One tiny slice of dried pineapple
options.C: Two large bowls of sliced watermelon

explanation: Spot on! One medium-sized whole fruit—like an orange, banana, or apple—makes a perfect single portion. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T010#GNS227_U4_T010_h3)

question: Why do whole fruits cause a slower, safer rise in blood sugar than fruit juices?

options.A: Whole fruits contain zero natural sugars unlike juice
options.B: The intact fiber slows down digestion and sugar absorption
options.C: Teexh enzymes block sugar from entering the bloodstream
options.D: Stomach acid instantly destroys all fruit sugars

explanation: Correct! The natural fiber in whole fruits acts like a speed bump, helping your body absorb the sugar nice and slowly. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T010#GNS227_U4_T010_h4)

question: Which of the following is NOT a benefit of choosing whole fruit over fruit juice?

options.A: Encouraging healthy chewing and saliva flow
options.B: Providing a concentrated dose of liquid sugar
options.C: Promoting a feeling of fullness after eating

explanation: You nailed it! Concentrated liquid sugar is actually found in juices, and it can cause your blood sugar to spike quickly. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T010#GNS227_U4_T010_h4)

question: What is a major advantage of eating seasonal local fruits here in Nigeria?

options.A: They contain no natural carbohydrates at all
options.C: They are imported directly from foreign countries
options.D: They are more affordable and readily available

explanation: Exactly! Buying local and in-season means fresher fruits that are kind to your wallet and easy to find in our markets. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T010#GNS227_U4_T010_h5)

question: Which of these is an indigenous fruit commonly found in Nigerian local markets?
explanation: Correct! Agbalumo is a beloved seasonal Nigerian fruit packed with wonderful vitamins and fiber. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T010#GNS227_U4_T010_h5)

question: A patient complains that fresh fruits spoil too quickly. What practical advice can you give?

options.A: Soak the fruits in salty water for forty-eight hours.
options.B: Stop buying fresh fruit completely and drink soda instead.
options.C: Leave all fruits uncovered under direct sunlight every day.
options.D: Freeze ripe fruits or store them properly to extend their usable shelf life.

explanation: Spot on! Proper refrigeration or freezing stops food from going waste, helping patients enjoy their fresh produce longer. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T010#GNS227_U4_T010_h6)

question: How does buying fruits in their natural season help families on a tight budget?

options.A: Farmers give away all seasonal fruits for free to hospitals
options.B: Seasonal fruits never require washing or preparation
options.C: Abundant supply during peak season drives market prices down
options.D: Government laws make out-of-season fruits illegal to sell

explanation: You got it! When farmers harvest a lot of a fruit during its peak season, the market price drops, making healthy eating budget-friendly. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T010#GNS227_U4_T010_h6)
